title: The Voice in the Memory
summary: As the portal stabilizes, an ancient telepathic bridge connects Ha-Jun's mind directly to Kang Tae-Jun's conscious soul floating in the Tartarus stasis chamber.

panels.shot: the glowing dimensional wormhole swirling in tranquil silence
panels.action: The violent vortex stabilizes into a mirror-smooth lake of vertical deep-violet light, reflecting alien constellations.
panels.prose_en: The violent vortex stabilizes into a mirror-smooth lake of vertical deep-violet light, reflecting alien constellations.
panels.prose_hi: Hinsak bhanwar udhrvadhar gahre-bangni prakash ki ek darpan-chikani jheel mein sthir ho jata hai, jo videshi nakshatron ko pratibimbit karta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun floating weightlessly in the center of the chamber
panels.action: Ha-Jun floats three feet above the flooded stone floor, his eyes shut as an ethereal golden chord connects to his forehead.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun floats three feet above the flooded stone floor, his eyes shut as an ethereal golden chord connects to his forehead.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun baadh wale patthar ke farsh se teen feet upar tairta hai, uski aankhen band ho jaati hain kyonki ek alaukik sunhara taar uske mathe se jud jata hai.

panels.shot: baek and min-jae watching in breathless awe from below
panels.action: Min-Jae whispers: 'He's communing across dimensions... Look at the frequency waves around his head.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: He's establishing a psychic link with Tartarus.

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae whispers: 'He's communing across dimensions... Look at the frequency waves around his head.'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je fusfusate hue kahte han: 'vah vibhinn aayamon mein sanchar kar raha hai... uske sir ke charon or aavritti tarangon ko dekhen.'

panels.shot: kuro perching on ha-jun shoulder acting as psychic antenna
panels.action: Kuro's ruby eyes burn with white-hot astral light, harmonizing Ha-Jun's brainwaves with the dimensional rift.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Frequency locked. Crossing the Tartarus firewall now.

panels.prose_en: Kuro's ruby eyes burn with white-hot astral light, harmonizing Ha-Jun's brainwaves with the dimensional rift.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ki ruby aankhen safed-garm sookshm prakash se jalti han, jo aayami daraar ke saath Ha-Jun ki mastishk tarangon ka samanjasya bithati hai.

panels.shot: transition into the soul mindscape: a twilight field of lilies
panels.action: Reality melts into an infinite field of luminous purple lilies under a sky filled with three giant crescent moons.
panels.prose_en: Reality melts into an infinite field of luminous purple lilies under a sky filled with three giant crescent moons.
panels.prose_hi: Teen vishal ardhchandron se bhare aakash ke neeche vastavikta chamakdar baingani lily ke ek anant kshetra mein pighal jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing in the flower field looking around bewildered
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down at the soft glowing petals beneath his boots: 'Where... Where am I?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh Asmodaius ka mindscape nahi hai... Yeh jagah bohot peaceful hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks down at the soft glowing petals beneath his boots: 'Where... Where am I?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne jooton ke neeche mulayam chamakti pankhudiyon ko dekhta hai: 'kahan... main kahan hun?'.

panels.shot: a tall silhouette standing fifty paces away under a cherry tree
panels.action: Fifty paces ahead, beneath an ethereal silver cherry blossom tree, stands the silhouette of a young man in black.
panels.prose_en: Fifty paces ahead, beneath an ethereal silver cherry blossom tree, stands the silhouette of a young man in black.
panels.prose_hi: Pachas kadam aage, ek alaukik silver cherry blossom ped ke niche, kale kapde pahane ek yuvak ki chhaya khadi hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun running forward through the sea of flowers
panels.action: Ha-Jun doesn't hesitate; he sprints through the purple lilies, petals swirling into the breeze around his legs.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun doesn't hesitate; he sprints through the purple lilies, petals swirling into the breeze around his legs.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sankoch nahin karta; wah baingani lily ke beech se daudta hai, pankhudiyan uske pairon ke charon or hawa mein ghumti han.

panels.shot: the silhouette slowly turning around with a gentle smile
panels.action: The figure turns: 22-year-old Kang Tae-Jun, tall, broad-shouldered, with identical handsome features and gentle eyes.
panels.prose_en: The figure turns: 22-year-old Kang Tae-Jun, tall, broad-shouldered, with identical handsome features and gentle eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Aakriti badal jaati hai: 22 varshiya kang Tae-Jun, lamba, chaude kandhe wala, samaan sundar visheshtaon aur komal aankhon wala.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking at ha-jun with eyes full of pride and wonder
panels.action: Tae-Jun chuckles softly, tears shining in his eyes: 'Look at how tall you've become, Ha-Jun. You're taller than me now.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun... Sach mein kitne bade ho gaye ho tum.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun chuckles softly, tears shining in his eyes: 'Look at how tall you've become, Ha-Jun. You're taller than me now.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun dheere se hansta hai, uski aankhon mein aansu chamakte han: 'dekho tum kitne lambe ho gaye ho, Ha-Jun. ab tum mujhse lambe ho.'

panels.shot: ha-jun colliding into tae-jun with an emotional bear hug
panels.action: Ha-Jun crashes into Tae-Jun's chest, burying his face into his brother's shoulder and clutching his jacket tightly.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hyung... Main kitna darr gaya tha... Maine socha main tumhe kho chuka hoon!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun crashes into Tae-Jun's chest, burying his face into his brother's shoulder and clutching his jacket tightly.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun Tae-Jun ki chhati se takrata hai, apna chehra apne bhai ke kandhe mein chhipa leta hai aur uski jacket ko kaskar pakad leta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun wrapping strong arms around ha-jun patting his back
panels.action: Tae-Jun wraps his arms around Ha-Jun, resting his chin on Ha-Jun's head with deep brotherly warmth.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Shh... Main yahin hoon. I'm right here. I never left you.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun wraps his arms around Ha-Jun, resting his chin on Ha-Jun's head with deep brotherly warmth.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne Ha-Jun ke charon or apni bahen lapet leen aur gahri bhaichare wali garmjoshi ke saath apni thuddi Ha-Jun ke sir par tika di.

panels.shot: the two brothers stepping back looking each other in the eye
panels.action: They step back slightly; Tae-Jun holds Ha-Jun's shoulders, inspecting his face with smiling affection.
panels.prose_en: They step back slightly; Tae-Jun holds Ha-Jun's shoulders, inspecting his face with smiling affection.
panels.prose_hi: Ve thoda peeche hat jaate han; Tae-Jun ne Ha-Jun ke kandhon ko pakad liya aur muskurate hue sneh ke saath uske chehre ka nirikshan kiya.

panels.shot: tae-jun noticing the crown of relics floating around ha-jun
panels.action: Tae-Jun looks at the ten ethereal relics orbiting Ha-Jun: 'You synchronized with all ten? You mastered the Sovereign's will?'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Ten relics... Ha-Jun, tumne impossible kar dikhaya.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun looks at the ten ethereal relics orbiting Ha-Jun: 'You synchronized with all ten? You mastered the Sovereign's will?'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun Ha-Jun ki parikrama kar rahe das ether avsheshon ko dekhta hai: 'aap sabhi dason ke saath taalmel bitha chuke han? aapne samprabhu ki ichchha par adhikar kar liya?'

panels.shot: ha-jun explaining how kuro and min-jae helped him survive
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'I didn't do it alone. Kuro guided me. And Min-Jae and Captain Baek had my back.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main akela nahi tha. Mere friends ne har step pe mera saath diya.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'I didn't do it alone. Kuro guided me. And Min-Jae and Captain Baek had my back.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun: 'maine ise akele nahin kiya. Kuro ne mera margdarshan kiya. aur min-je aur captain bak ne mera saath diya.'

panels.shot: tae-jun expression turning solemn as time begins to tick
panels.action: Tae-Jun looks toward the three moons: 'Ha-Jun, this psychic link won't last long. My body is in the Tartarus Spire.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Listen carefully. Tartarus Spire mein Seventh Void Sovereign 'Malakor' meri physical body guard kar raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun looks toward the three moons: 'Ha-Jun, this psychic link won't last long. My body is in the Tartarus Spire.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun teen chandramaon ki or dekhta hai: 'Ha-Jun, yah mansik sambandh lambe samay tak nahin rahega. mera shareer tarters spire mein hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun manifesting a glowing astral map of the tartarus spire
panels.action: Between them, Tae-Jun projects an intricate 3D map of an obsidian floating fortress surrounded by black lightning.
panels.prose_en: Between them, Tae-Jun projects an intricate 3D map of an obsidian floating fortress surrounded by black lightning.
panels.prose_hi: Unke bich, Tae-Jun kali bijli se ghire ek obsidian tairte kile ka ek jatil 3d manchitra pesh karta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun pointing to the central spire apex
panels.action: Tae-Jun: 'The stasis pod is suspended in the Chamber of Frozen Souls. It's powered by a Null-Mana core.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Chamber mein ordinary magic kaam nahi karega. You must rely on physical sword skill and the Feather's Mythic light.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun: 'The stasis pod is suspended in the Chamber of Frozen Souls. It's powered by a Null-Mana core.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun: 'stacis pod ko frozen souls ke chamber mein nilambit kar diya gaya hai. yah nal-mana core dwara sanchalit hai.'

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding firmly memorizing every corridor of the fortress
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes scan the layout, committing every corridor, defense turret, and patrol route to memory.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Chamber of Frozen Souls... Level 88... Main ek ek inch yaad rakhunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes scan the layout, committing every corridor, defense turret, and patrol route to memory.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen layout ko scan karti han, pratyek galiyare, raksha burj aur gashti marg ko smriti mein le jaati han.

panels.shot: tae-jun hands beginning to turn semi-transparent in the breeze
panels.action: Tae-Jun's fingertips begin to dissolve into floating starlight as the psychic tether destabilizes.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Mera connection weak ho raha hai... The Void Priests are injecting neuro-suppressants into my tank.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun's fingertips begin to dissolve into floating starlight as the psychic tether destabilizes.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi mansik bandhan asthir hota hai, Tae-Jun ki ungaliyan tairti hui taron ki roshni mein ghulne lagti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun grabbing tae-jun fading hand tightly
panels.action: Ha-Jun grabs his brother's fading hand with both of his: 'Don't let go! I'm coming right now!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hold on, Hyung! Main gate se enter kar raha hoon!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun grabs his brother's fading hand with both of his: 'Don't let go! I'm coming right now!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne bhai ke lupt hote hathon ko apne donon hathon se pakadta hai: 'jane mat do! main abhi aa raha hun!'

panels.shot: tae-jun smiling with radiant warmth and absolute faith
panels.action: Tae-Jun smiles calmly, his face bathed in starlight: 'I know you will. I have always believed in you, Little Sovereign.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Mujhe tumpe pura bharosa hai. See you in Tartarus, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun smiles calmly, his face bathed in starlight: 'I know you will. I have always believed in you, Little Sovereign.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun shanti se muskurata hai, uska chehra taron ki roshni mein nahaya hua hai: 'mujhe pata hai tum aisa karoge. little soweren, maine hamesha aap par vishwas kiya hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun silhouette completely dissolving into golden particles
panels.action: Tae-Jun dissolves into millions of sparkling golden fireflies that rise into the twilight sky.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun dissolves into millions of sparkling golden fireflies that rise into the twilight sky.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun lakhon chamchamate sunhare juganuon mein vilin ho jata hai jo godhuli aakash mein ugte han.

panels.shot: the field of lilies dissolving back into cold reality
panels.action: The purple lilies fade; the concrete cavern and flooded subsea tunnel crystallize back into view.
panels.prose_en: The purple lilies fade; the concrete cavern and flooded subsea tunnel crystallize back into view.
panels.prose_hi: Bangni lily murjha jaati hai; concrete ki gufa aur pani se bhari upsamudra surang wapas drishya mein cristlikrit ho jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes snapping open with blinding purple radiance
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes snap open; a shockwave of raw telekinetic force clears the water ten meters around him.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes snap open; a shockwave of raw telekinetic force clears the water ten meters around him.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen khul gain; kacchi telicanatic bal ki ek shockwev uske charon or ke pani ko das meter tak saaf kar deti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing softly onto the dry concrete floor
panels.action: Ha-Jun drops lightly onto his boots, his coat settling smoothly around his knees.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun drops lightly onto his boots, his coat settling smoothly around his knees.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun halke se apne jooton par girta hai, uska coat uske ghutnon ke aaspaas aasani se baith jata hai.

panels.shot: min-jae and baek rushing over: 'did you reach him?!'
panels.action: Min-Jae runs over: 'Ha-Jun! Did you make contact?! Is Tae-Jun really alive?!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Did you see him?! Is he okay?!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae runs over: 'Ha-Jun! Did you make contact?! Is Tae-Jun really alive?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je daudta hai: 'Ha-Jun! kya aapne sampark kiya?! kya Tae-Jun sachmuch jeevit hai?!'

panels.shot: ha-jun nodding with the most confident smile of his life
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with warmth and steel: 'He's alive. And he's waiting for us in Tartarus Spire.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Wo zinda hai. Aur wo hamara wait kar raha hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smiles with warmth and steel: 'He's alive. And he's waiting for us in Tartarus Spire.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun garmjoshi aur dridhta ke saath muskurata hai: 'vah jeevit hai. aur wah tarters spire mein hamara intjaar kar raha hai.'

panels.shot: kuro screeching a battle cry as his wings flare with mythic violet flames
panels.action: Kuro spreads his massive wings, engulfing the cavern in blinding violet hellfire: 'Then let us march!'
panels.prose_en: Kuro spreads his massive wings, engulfing the cavern in blinding violet hellfire: 'Then let us march!'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne vishal pankh failata hai, gufa ko andhi baingani rang ki narkankaal ki aag mein gher leta hai: 'to aaie hum march karen!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing his sword pointing straight into the wormhole
panels.action: Ha-Jun points the Sanguine Fang directly into the center of the dimensional gate: 'Target: Tartarus Spire. Move out!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun points the Sanguine Fang directly into the center of the dimensional gate: 'Target: Tartarus Spire. Move out!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun senguin feng ko sidhe aayami dwar ke kendra mein ingit karta hai: 'lakshya: tarters spir. ghar chhod dena!'.
